subject.title: Add a Computer Use plugin manifest contract

question: Should OpenClaw accept `contracts.computerUseProviders` and `computerUseProviderMetadata` as a public metadata-only plugin manifest contract for Computer Use discovery tied to macOS Accessibility and Screen Recording binding?
rationale: The issue is additive and aligned with manifest-first plugin discovery, but the contract would become public plugin API and may influence a host permission boundary that automation cannot define safely.

options.title: Accept after PR review
options.body: Review the linked PR, confirm the field names and permission semantics, and land it only with docs, tests, and generated-doc freshness fixed.

options.title: Revise the contract shape
options.body: Narrow or rename the manifest fields, platform metadata, permission enum, or MCP metadata before freezing the public contract.

options.title: Pause for host design
options.body: Keep the issue and PR open until the macOS host discovery and trust model are firmer.

recommendation.title: Accept after PR review
recommendation.body: Review the linked PR, confirm the field names and permission semantics, and land it only with docs, tests, and generated-doc freshness fixed.

likelyOwner.reason: Recent plugin manifest metadata history and adjacent Computer Use/security-boundary context make this the best available owner for the public contract decision.
